aggregate_use.reason: AdSERP generates one SERP per trial: across the 2,437 pool trials there are 2,437 distinct pages and 2,437 distinct task ids, and no page or task id is seen by more than 1 participant. The claim that a 0.69 per-instance score becomes a clean separation when averaged over participants viewing the same result cannot be tested on this dataset; it needs a corpus where one page is served to many sessions.
